**LOGOS & BRANDING**
*   **Celsius Logo (Top Right):**
    *   **Icon:** A stylized blue graphic resembling a swirl or airflow lines.
    *   **Text:** "Celsius" in bold, dark blue sans-serif font.
    *   **Tagline:** "Experts in keeping things cool" in smaller text beneath the brand name.
*   **Havelock Dental Center Logo (Inside Image):**
    *   **Icon:** A brown/gold 3D-style tooth with a ring around it, resembling a planet or Saturn.
    *   **Text:** "Havelock Dental Center" in a serif font below the icon.
    *   **Tagline:** "Since 1970" in small text under the name.

**HEADLINE / MAIN TITLE**
> HAVELOCK DENTAL CENTER

**BODY TEXT / CAPTIONS (Within Images)**
*   Havelock Dental Center
*   Since 1970

**PAGE NUMBERING**
*   20

**VISUAL ELEMENTS & DESCRIPTIONS**
*   **Color Palette:**
    *   Primary Blue (Cyan/Turquoise) used for the large abstract shape in the top left corner and the page number background.
    *   Light Blue/White gradient for the secondary part of the header shape.
    *   White background for the main content area.
    *   Dark Blue for the Celsius logo and page number text.
*   **Icons/Graphics:**
    *   Large abstract curved shape (blue to white gradient) occupying the top left quadrant.
    *   Page number "20" contained within a rounded square badge with a dark blue background at the bottom left.
*   **Photography Content:**
    *   **Image 1 (Large Left):** Reception area of the dental center featuring wooden ceiling panels, recessed lighting, a long reception desk with a wood countertop, and the center's branded wall logo. An automatic hand sanitizer dispenser is visible on the counter.
    *   **Image 2 (Top Middle-Left):** Installation photo showing workers on ladders installing ceiling infrastructure (likely ductwork or AC units).
    *   **Image 3 (Top Middle-Right):** Waiting area with a row of white chairs against a wall with subtle dot patterns, wooden ceiling slats, and a reception counter.
    *   **Image 4 (Top Right):** Dental operatory room showing a dental chair, delivery system, overhead dental light, and a wall-mounted split air conditioner above a window.
    *   **Image 5 (Bottom Middle-Left):** Another angle of a dental chair and equipment near a window with greenery outside. A split AC unit is mounted high on the wall.
    *   **Image 6 (Bottom Middle-Right):** Exterior view of the building showing multiple outdoor units (condensers) of air conditioning systems mounted on an exterior wall.
    *   **Image 7 (Bottom Right):** Second dental operatory view showing the chair, cabinetry, sink, and another wall-mounted split AC unit.

**CONTACT INFO**
*   None explicitly listed as body text (only the Celsius tagline implies service).
